title: Narrow ooRexx/BSF4ooRexx integration boundary
summary: The ooRexx integration surface is intentionally narrow: recursively convert ooRexx table/directory/array values into ordinary Java Map/List Wire objects, call WireSwingRuntime.accept, and drain outbound/action records. Do not expose arbitrary Swing widgets as ooRexx application objects.
invariants: WireSwingRuntime owns EDT marshalling even when .AwtGuiThread is available as an additional launcher safety layer.
The bridge does not make JButton/JPanel/JTextField objects part of application authority.
A BSF-compatible static WireSwingRuntime.create() factory is intentional because BSF v850 constructor resolution rejected the ordinary default constructor in the qualified environment.
Java VM native loader/library-path setup is a launcher concern, not a Wire contract.
Top-level JFrame lifecycle remains behind WireSwingDesktopWindow/bridge methods rather than being exposed for arbitrary mutation.
procedure: Convert inbound ooRexx values recursively to Java collections/scalars.
Pass the resulting Wire message to WireSwingRuntime.
Drain outbound protocol/action maps and recursively convert them back to ooRexx values.
Keep all component and JFrame objects private to the Java renderer/desktop facade.

provenance.claim: Qualified narrow ooRexx/BSF bridge and interoperability findings.
